item.title: Author Explores Cybersecurity Risks of Driverless Cars
item.description: Former New York City Traffic Commissioner Sam Schwartz joins hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend and warns that the expansion of autonomous vehicles brings cybersecurity risks, including the possibility that bad actors could seize control of connected cars and use them as weapons. His new novel, Autokill, explores that threat while Schwartz argues that autonomous vehicles still have significant safety potential if companies provide greater transparency and governments prepare for emerging risks. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Google Maps Changes Lake Ontario Label to Lake America in US
item.description: Google Maps relabeled Lake Ontario as “Lake America” for users in the US, Alphabet Inc. announced, after President Donald Trump said he would rename the lake amid a trade spat with Canada.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Cohrs Zhang

item.description: Also: Apple experimented with a Pencil for the coming foldable iPhone.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: G20 Faces Divide Over Debt, AI and Global Growth
item.description: G20 finance officials are gathering in North Carolina with sovereign debt, global imbalances and economic growth in focus, but CSIS Director of Economics Program Philip Luck joins Bloomberg This Weekend and says the US and its partners increasingly disagree over both the problems and how to address them. A separate technology meeting will bring Elon Musk, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and OpenAI’s Sam Altman into discussions over AI and emerging technologies as Washington pushes for a lighter regulatory framework. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: PetroChina First-Half Profit Rises 22% on Higher Oil Prices
item.description: PetroChina Co. posted a 22% increase in first-half profit as a surge in global energy prices boosted upstream revenue at China’s biggest oil and gas producer.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
item.description: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nepal Races to Find Missing Amid Threats of Further Flooding
item.description: Nepal raced to find thousands still missing as rising water levels and worsening weather threaten to hamper rescue efforts, five days after a glacial collapse unleashed catastrophic flooding along the border with China.
item.dc:creator: Dan Strumpf and Sankalp Phartiyal
